title: The Best AI Game, is actually building games
author: captian2
selftext: I have built around 10 games using AI development, and I play them with my kids and their friends. They suggest new games and I build those so we can try them together. They give feedback and we update and change the games... Honestly, the best game is building games itself. It is so much fun to take classic games and add my own twist on them and change them up with my kids to make them new again. I don't think most if any of my games have mass appeal or will make money, but building AI games is almost as fun as playing most games.

comments.author: emperormarkus
comments.body:
You have this spot on. I think we are on the same page here exactly.

My son and I have made around 20 home brew games and have tried out all sorts of different game mechanics and styles.

I have made C64-style games (super easy with AI), racing games, history strategy games and more.

The building is really the fun part. We also love the fact that we can put in whatever we like.

We made a city building game set in Ancient Greece and decided it would be cool to have a car drive around it. Who cares? Do what you like.

I also use the process as a learning process for my son. We built a website and post blogs. We also are looking at an app. For me it is fun and a great way to stay relevant with the next generation.
